mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees at Verona Area High School with light drizzle and an air quality index of 51. We are under a Third Quarter moon, and while the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 58 degrees with rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced the hiring of Liz Gay as the new EMS Deputy Chief, effective November 2. She brings extensive experience in emergency operations and healthcare instruction. Additionally, residents are reminded that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles local refuse and recycling, with specific guidelines for cart placement and bulk waste available on the city website.

Today, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow, the town is buzzing with trivia options including Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable report, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue on October 25, where they found a man passed out behind the wheel and arrested him for an O W I.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
